population.kidComparison: Ethiopia is one of the world's most populated nations, home to about 135.5 million people.

geography.climate: Warm tropical climate year-round with distinct wet and dry seasons.
geography.terrain: Inland terrain bordered by neighboring countries.

anthem.title: National Anthem of Ethiopia
anthem.summary: The official patriotic anthem played at national ceremonies in Ethiopia.

exploration.didYouKnow: Ethiopia is located in Eastern Africa and its capital city is Addis Ababa.
